errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS.source: The sign-in details you entered are incorrect.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS.context: Sign-in failed: wrong email/mobile or password. Keep it generic - never say which part was wrong

errors.TENANT_UNAVAILABLE.source: This institute is not available right now.
errors.TENANT_UNAVAILABLE.context: Sign-in refused because the institute site is unavailable or suspended

errors.USER_SUSPENDED.source: The sign-in details you entered are incorrect.
errors.USER_SUSPENDED.context: Sign-in refused for a suspended account. Use exactly the same text as errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS (anti-enumeration)

errors.DEVICE_LIMIT_REACHED.source: You have reached the maximum number of devices for this account. Ask your institute to remove a device.

errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.source: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.context: Rate limit reached, e.g. too many failed sign-ins

errors.MOBILE_LOGIN_DISABLED.source: Sign-in with a mobile number is turned off for this institute. Use your email instead.
errors.MOBILE_LOGIN_DISABLED.context: Mobile-number sign-in is disabled by the institute

errors.NETWORK_ERROR.source: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR.context: The browser could not contact the server

errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR.context: Fallback for an unexpected server response

errors.SELF_ENROLLMENT_DISABLED.source: Self-enrollment is turned off. Contact your institute to join this course.
errors.SELF_ENROLLMENT_DISABLED.context: Student tried to enroll while the institute disabled self-enrollment

errors.TRANSLATION_INVALID.source: This translation is not valid. Fix the problems listed and try again.
errors.TRANSLATION_INVALID.context: Translation editor: the server rejected the message format

errors.TRANSLATION_DRAFT_STALE.source: This translation was changed by someone else. Reload to see the latest version.
errors.TRANSLATION_DRAFT_STALE.context: Translation editor: optimistic-concurrency conflict on a draft

errors.TRANSLATION_RELEASE_STALE.source: Someone published or rolled back translations in the meantime. Reload and try again.

errors.NOTHING_TO_PUBLISH.source: There are no draft changes to publish for this language.

errors.UNKNOWN_MESSAGE_KEY.source: This text key does not exist.

errors.LOCALE_NOT_ENABLED.source: This language is not enabled for this institute.
errors.LOCALE_NOT_ENABLED.context: Language exists but the institute has not enabled it

errors.PO_IMPORT_INVALID.source: The translation file contains invalid messages. Nothing was imported.

errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.source: The file is too large. The maximum size is 1 MB.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.context: Upload larger than the allowed size
